title: The Third Knock
source: Production brief: The Third Knock, Episode 01 (owner, 2026-11-07)

style.look: minimalist 2D illustrated animation, flat and softly shaded shapes, simple readable character design, dark navy, charcoal and muted blue palette, warm yellow lamp and beacon light, strong silhouettes and controlled shadows, cinematic dark atmosphere, not photorealistic, not 3D
style.look_scene: minimalist 2D illustrated background art, flat and softly shaded, dark navy, charcoal and muted blue palette, warm yellow light accents, strong shadows, cinematic dark atmosphere, not photorealistic, not 3D
style.negative: photorealistic, 3D render, glossy CGI, anime, readable text, letters, watermark, logo, extra fingers, deformed face, cluttered

elias.description: Elias, a young man about 26, short dark hair, simple minimalist illustrated face, yellow raincoat, dark navy trousers, dark boots, slim build, no accessories

lighthouse_exterior.description: Blackwater Lighthouse, an isolated lighthouse on a small rocky island at night, dark navy ocean, heavy rain and storm clouds, large waves on the rocks, rotating warm yellow beacon, no people

control_room.description: the inside of a small old keeper's control room at the top of a tower, seen from inside and filling the whole frame: wooden desk, old closed notebook, vintage radio with a red indicator light, warm desk lamp, wooden chair, two or three small windows that show only dark rain, storm clouds and a dark sea (no buildings or towers outside), muted blue shadows and warm yellow highlights, no people

staircase.description: a narrow lighthouse staircase seen from above, dark walls, strong vertical perspective, limited light, long shadows, no people

entrance.description: the lighthouse entrance at the bottom of the stairs: a heavy old wooden door with a narrow glass window beside it, warm interior light, dark rainy night outside the glass, no people

narrator.description: Will's voice is a young adult man of about 25, natural, warm and intimate, like telling a story, speaking at a calm, measured pace with clear pauses between sentences. The recording is very clear and close-up, with almost no background noise.

elias.description: Will's voice is a young adult man of about 25, natural and slightly nervous, speaking at a calm, measured pace with clear pauses between sentences. The recording is very clear and close-up, with almost no background noise.

stranger.description: Will's voice is a young adult man of about 25, quiet, calm and slow in an unsettling way, speaking at a calm, measured pace with clear pauses between sentences. The recording is very clear and close-up, with almost no background noise.

radio.description: Bruce speaks in a deep, low-pitched mature male voice, slow, calm but urgent. The recording is very clear, with almost no background noise.

notes: Converted from the owner's production brief. Narration is Elias (first person) -> same voice as Elias. The Stranger reuses Elias's voice (fx stranger) and design (Elias reference, face hidden). Radio lines are voice-only with the radio filter. Notebook, HUD, final screen and choices are drawn as overlays (exact spelling), never inside artwork.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.tts: Nobody wanted the night shift at Blackwater Lighthouse. So they offered me double pay.
lines.caption: Nobody wanted the night shift at Blackwater Lighthouse. So they offered me double pay.

shots.keyframe_prompt: wide establishing view of Blackwater Lighthouse on a small rocky island in a night storm, large waves striking the rocks, heavy rain, the warm yellow beacon shining
shots.motion_prompt: slow camera push towards the lighthouse, waves crash on the rocks, rain falls, the beacon beam sweeps slowly

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.tts: On the desk, I found a notebook. Five rules. No explanation.
lines.caption: On the desk, I found a notebook. Five rules. No explanation.

overlays.text:
RULES FOR THE NIGHT KEEPER
1. Keep the lighthouse beam running.
2. Never open the entrance after midnight.
3. Ignore voices coming from the ocean.
4. If the radio turns on by itself, do not respond.
5. If someone knocks three times, never answer.

lines.tts: Whatever happens tonight... do not open the door.
lines.caption: Whatever happens tonight... do not open the door.
